page.content:
Han envoy whose reports opened the Western Regions to Chinese policy.

How Zhang Qian connects

  • Character: Emperor Wu of Han — Zhang Qian traveled as Emperor Wu's envoy to the Western Regions.
  • Faction: Yuezhi — Zhang Qian's brief was to find the Yuezhi as allies against the Xiongnu.
  • Location: Overland Silk Road — Zhang Qian's reports made the overland west a standing Han concern.

What is Zhang Qian?

Zhang Qian's missions (138–126 BCE and after) for Emperor Wu reached the Yuezhi and Ferghana. His geography made the Han court treat Central Asia as a reachable diplomatic field.

Key threads lead to Emperor Wu of Han, Yuezhi and Overland Silk Road.
